title: poa flexuosa subsp. fernaldiana
intro: Poa flexuosa subsp. fernaldiana, commonly known as Fernald's bentgrass, is a subspecies of grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions attributed to Fernald's bentgrass include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
